heroHeadline: Zelenskyy Offers to Hold Elections if Russia Agrees to 60-Day Ceasefire
heroSubtitle: In a significant diplomatic concession amid Trump pressure, Zelenskyy tied elections to a 60-day ceasefire, while drone strikes on Kyiv bridges and glide bombs on Kharkiv continue to inflict civilian casualties.
